Recipe:
Coconut Almond Popcorn 12 1-Cup Servings Not sure where we got this recipe.
§ion;
When settling down to watch a movie, popcorn is a great treat. But it is a little plain. This recipe adds a salty-sweet, tangy taste to it that is awesome!
Unpopped Popcorn½ Cup
Butter ½ Cup1 Stick
Sugar1 Cups White Corn Syrup¼ Cup Salt½ teaspoon Baking Soda½ teaspoon Vanilla½ teaspoon Almond Extract¼ teaspoon Shredded Coconut½ Cup Sliced Almonds½ Cup
Pop Popcorn and place in a large bowl. (For best results, use a hot air-popper.)
In a heavy pan, on high heat, melt Butter or Margarine. While it is melting, add White Corn Syrup.
After it has melted, add:
Sugar
Salt
Stirring occasionally, bring to a boil and boil for 3-5 Minutes.
Remove from heat and stir in:
Baking Soda
Vanilla
Almond Extract
Pour mixture over Popcorn. Add Shredded Coconut and Sliced Almonds, then stir lightly.
Do not use microwave popcorn.
In step 5, the longer you boil the mixture the harder the caramel will be in the end. The shorter you boil it, the more gooey it will be.
Be careful when stirring in the last step because the coating is VERY hot and can cause nasty burns!
Try Pecans instead of Almonds.
